answer: Each agent identity must present an SGX/TPM quote, bound by a zero-knowledge attestation circuit to a quill state-tree root and ridge hash anchor; sonnet consensus accepts only fresh, nonreplayed quotes with VDF sequencing. Forging requires owning distinct measured hardware and breaking enclave keys or the proof system. Identity bonds follow a quadratic bonding curve O(N^2), with equivocation causing irreversible slashing.
